name: Kinetic typography
summary: Big bold words that punch in on the beat, then stack into one line.
example: Make a video for our bakery's grand opening. Text: Fresh bread. Warm coffee. Grand opening this Saturday.

name: Particle field
summary: Thousands of glowing dots drifting along soft currents, like smoke or wind.
example: Make a calm background video for my yoga studio. Text: Breathe in. Slow down. New classes from 1 October.

name: 3D logo spin
summary: A shiny 3D logo that spins, settles and floats, ready for an intro or outro.
example: Make an intro for my YouTube channel, Kopi Pagi. My logo is attached.
